title: Back End Developer
description_preview:
About The Company
IBM, or International Business Machines Corporation, is a global leader in technology and consulting services, renowned for its innovation and commitment to advancing the digital landscape. With a rich history spanning over a century, IBM has consistently been at the forefront of technological breakthroughs, providing solutions that empower businesses and communities worldwide. The company's expertise encompasses cloud computing, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cybersecurity, and enterprise solutions, making it a trusted partner for organizations seeking to transform their operations and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving digital environment.
IBM fosters a culture of continuous learning, diversity, and inclusion, encouraging employees to innovate and push boundaries. Its global presence and dedication to sustainability and social responsibility make it an ideal workplace for professionals eager to make a meaningful impact through cutting-edge technology.
About The Role
We are seeking a talented and motivated Backend Developer to join our dynamic team at IBM. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend solutions that support our innovative cloud services and enterprise applications. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including frontend developers, DevOps engineers, and product managers, to deliver high-quality software that meets our clients' needs. Your expertise will contribute to creating robust APIs, managing server-side logic, and ensuring the seamless integration of our cloud-based platforms. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on large-scale systems and cutting-edge technologies, making a tangible impact on our clients' digital transformation journeys.
The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in backend development, a passion for problem-solving, and a keen interest in cloud and DevOps methodologies. You will be part of a forward-thinking organization that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Qualifications
High School Diploma or GED is required.
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
Basic knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or Node.js.
Understanding of client-server architectures, networking protocols, and database management.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as IBM Cloud, AWS, or Azure.
Knowledge of API development, particularly RESTful services.
Experience with Agile and DevOps development methodologies is a plus.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
Responsibilities
Develop, test, and maintain backend applications and services that support enterprise solutions and cloud platforms.
Create and configure Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS) applications to meet client requirements.
Design and implement clean, efficient, and well-documented APIs to facilitate integration and usability.
Develop server-side firmware, databases, and application logic that are scalable, reusable, and aligned with architectural standards.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical specifications and ensure seamless integration of systems.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and deployment processes to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by adopting best practices in cloud development and DevOps.
Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends to incorporate innovative solutions into projects.
Benefits
IBM offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional growth of its employees. This includes competitive salary packages, health insurance plans, retirement savings options, and paid time off. Employees have access to ongoing training and development programs to enhance their skills and career progression. IBM also promotes a flexible work environment, encouraging work-life balance and remote working opportunities. Additionally, employees can participate in various wellness initiatives, employee resource groups, and community engagement activities, fostering a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture.
Equal Opportunity
IBM is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We believe that a diverse workforce drives innovation and reflects the global communities we serve. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic.

description_preview:
About The Company
Northrop Grumman is a leading global security and aerospace company dedicated to providing innovative solutions that advance the security, stability, and well-being of our nation and the world. With a rich history of pioneering technological advancements, Northrop Grumman has been at the forefront of aerospace and defense innovation, contributing to missions that impact people's lives around the globe. Our culture fosters intellectual curiosity, diversity, and inclusion, encouraging employees to bring their whole selves to work and to pursue bold ideas that push the boundaries of possibility. From historic achievements like the first transatlantic flight and lunar landings to modern stealth and cybersecurity systems, Northrop Grumman continues to shape the future of aerospace and defense technology.
About The Role
We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Associate Software Engineer or Software Engineer to join our dynamic Software Engineering directorate at our Aeronautics Systems Sector in Melbourne, Florida. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of cutting-edge systems that have a significant impact on national security and aerospace innovation. The successful candidate will be involved in designing, developing, testing, and debugging complex applications and systems that require logical and mathematical solutions. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams, including hardware engineers and equipment designers, to develop electronic data processing systems for both product and commercial software applications.
In this role, you will analyze system capabilities, resolve technical problems, and ensure that software standards are met. Your work will include preparing operating instructions, designing and developing compilers, assemblers, utility programs, and operating systems. This position offers a challenging environment where innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence are highly valued. The role may require occasional travel and the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance, reflecting the sensitive nature of the projects involved.
Qualifications
To qualify for the Associate Software Engineer (T01) position, candidates must be completing or have completed their Bachelor's degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math) field from an accredited institution by August 2027. Candidates must demonstrate the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance and any required program access within a reasonable timeframe.
For the Software Engineer (T02) level, candidates should have either completed their Master's degree or have a Bachelor's degree with at least two years of relevant software engineering experience, both from an accredited institution, with an expected graduation date of August 2027 or earlier. Similar to the T01 level, candidates must be able to secure and retain a Top Secret clearance and related access.
Preferred qualifications include a cumulative GPA of 3.25 or higher, prior internship or work experience, leadership capabilities, teamwork skills, and active participation in extracurricular activities. Strong interpersonal communication skills and a demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in team environments are also highly valued.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, document, test, and debug software applications and systems that incorporate logical and mathematical solutions.
Conduct multidisciplinary research in collaboration with hardware engineers and equipment designers to develop electronic data processing systems for both product and commercial applications.
Analyze system capabilities to identify and resolve issues related to program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, and programming controls.
Prepare comprehensive operating instructions and technical documentation for developed systems.
Design and develop compilers, assemblers, utility programs, and operating systems to support software applications.
Ensure all software development activities adhere to established standards and best practices.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and validation processes to maintain high-quality software deliverables.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate hardware and software components effectively.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and incorporate them into ongoing projects to improve system capabilities.
Benefits
Northrop Grumman offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees. Benefits include health insurance coverage, including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as life and disability insurance. Employees are also eligible for a robust savings plan, including retirement options, and are provided with paid holidays and generous paid time off (PTO) for vacation and personal needs. Depending on the position, employees may also be eligible for overtime pay, shift differentials, and discretionary bonuses that reward individual contributions and company performance. Long-term incentives may be available for employees in senior leadership roles. We are committed to fostering a positive work environment that promotes professional growth, work-life balance, and employee recognition.
Equal Opportunity

We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. We believe in creating a workplace where all employees can thrive and contribute their unique perspectives and talents. For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit our website.
